waterbodies.name: Two Rivers SRA/WMA
waterbodies.regs: Black Bass - 21-inch minimum length limit. Channel and Blue Catfish - catch-and-release at Lakes 3 and 4. Trout fishing in Lake No. 5 is best from April 1 to early June. Open dates for trout fishing will be published and posted.  Trout fishing hours are 7 a.m. to sunset. Daily trout tag required to attempt to take and to possess trout on the entire area from March 1 through June 30. Cost of a tag is $6 (purchase at park office), which allows the harvest of four trout. Anglers may purchase up to three tags and can possess up to 12 trout. An adult angler is allowed to have two children under 16 fish under their tag, but the group is still limited to four trout per tag. One pole or rod and reel per angler on Lake No. 5 No tag is required to fish Lake No. 5 from July 1 through Jan. 31
